Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 6) demonstrates a small right hemithorax with ipsilateral mediastinal shift (dextroposition of the heart) and a curvilinear opacity in the right lower lung zone (indicated by the arrow), which represents the anomalous pulmonary vein characteristic of Scimitar syndrome. The CT images further confirm right-sided hypoplasia and vascular anomalies consistent with this congenital condition.
